name: St. Joseph
title: Spouse of the Blessed Virgin Mary
patron_of: Workers, fathers, families, and the universal Church
biography_short: St. Joseph was the faithful guardian of Jesus and Mary and a model of humble obedience.
biography_long: St. Joseph was chosen by God to be the husband of Mary and foster father of Jesus. Scripture presents him as righteous, obedient, and protective. He listened to God's guidance, cared for the Holy Family, and lived his vocation in quiet faithfulness. The Church honors him as patron of the universal Church.
reflection: Joseph teaches us that faithful love often works quietly, protecting life and serving God's plan one step at a time.
prayer: St. Joseph, guardian of the Holy Family, protect our homes and teach us faithful obedience. Pray for us.
